Predicates:
MovedTo(x, y) ::: x moved to y.
Private(x) ::: x is a private institution.
IvyLeague(x) ::: x is an Ivy League institution.
ResearchUniversity(x) ::: x is a research university.
Yale(x) ::: x is Yale University.
Location(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
EndowmentValue(x, y) ::: x's endowment was valued at y.
OrganizedInto(x, y) ::: x is organized into y.
CollegeOrSchool(y) ::: y is a college or school.
ResidentialCollege(y) ::: y is a residential college.
GraduateSchool(y) ::: y is a graduate school.
ProfessionalSchool(y) ::: y is a professional school.
YaleResidentialCollege(y) ::: y is a Yale residential college.
At(y, x) ::: y is at location x.
Value(y) ::: y is a value.
Year(y) ::: y is a year.
ListOf(y, x) ::: y is a list of x.
Name(y, x) ::: y has name x.
QuestionPredicate(y) ::: y is the question statement.
Conclusion(y) ::: y is the conclusion to evaluate.

Premises:
Yale(x) ∧ Private(x) ∧ IvyLeague(x) ∧ ResearchUniversity(x) ::: Yale University is a private Ivy League research university.
MovedTo(yale, newHaven) ::: Yale University moved to New Haven.
Location(yale, newHaven) ::: Yale University is located in New Haven.
EndowmentValue(yale, 42.3_billion) ::: Yale University's endowment was valued at $42.3 billion.
OrganizedInto(yale, yalesCollegesAndSchools) ::: Yale University has been organized into 27 constituent colleges and schools.
ListOf(yalesCollegesAndSchools, [BenjaminFranklin, Berkeley, Branford, Davenport, EzraStiles, GraceHopper, JonathanEdwards, Morse, PauliMurray, Pierson, Saybrook, Silliman, TimothyDwight, Trumbull]) ::: List of Yale's colleges and schools.
